# Scientific workload audit: no justified new enabled operation

Date: 2026-10-16. Worker: ge_scientific_workload. All original research packets
were treated read-only. No installs, acquired executable code, outreach, Git
operations, or subagents were used.

## Decision

One published scientific workload exactly satisfies the original interchange
hypotheses and needs full permutation/cycle information: the u=1 subcase of
Barp et al.'s 3D cycle-distribution study. It does not justify promoting the
delivered certifier as a new enabling operation. An equally informed exact
endpoint sampler is already O(n) expected events at its studied horizons,
whereas the delivered exterior implementation does not cover its branching grid.
Whole-cube conditional shuffling is provably wrong by more than .5 in full TV
on the published beta<=1, L>=80 regime. This is a scoped rejection, not a lower
bound against every conceivable cycle-specific approximation.

Quantum random-SWAP consensus gives a rigorous and potentially reusable diamond-
norm transfer. This search did not acquire an actual finite-time full-channel
decision with supplied heterogeneous rates, a scientifically owned tolerance,
complete physical-error bounds, and a demonstrated win over exact/averaged
incumbents. Asymptotic twirling and reduced-state consensus already have cheaper
same-information solutions.

Consequential new operation/decision enabled: **NOT_ESTABLISHED**.
Historical novelty: **UNKNOWN**. Physical capability: **UNKNOWN**.
Practical superiority: **NOT_ESTABLISHED**. No material data are asserted.

## The concrete full-output scientific workload

[Barp, Barp, Briol, Ueltschi](https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/id/eprint/75301/),
*A numerical study of the 3D random interchange and random loop models*,
J. Phys. A 48 (2015) 345002,
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1088/1751-8113/48/34/345002),
[arXiv:1505.00983v2](https://arxiv.org/html/1505.00983v2), dated 2015-07-14.
Their u=1 model has independent rate-1 nearest-neighbor transpositions on a cube
at horizon beta. Their scientific outputs include the joint cycle/shadow-length
partition and its moments, with cubes L=80 and L=160; a displayed full-partition
sample uses beta=1. They report numerical critical parameters in [0.313,0.361]
across their model family. Their double-bar variants and quantum-spin ensembles
weighted by 2^(number of loops) are different measures.

# Exact workload transfer and its boundaries

Status: internal derivation, not external theorem review or historical-priority clearance.

## 1. Classical endpoint contract

Let G=(V,E) be finite, undirected, and supplied. Each edge e has a fixed nonnegative
rate w_e that does not depend on labels, colors, configuration, or time. At an
independent Poisson clock ring, exchange the two endpoint labels. Start from a
deterministic permutation. For horizon T, use dimensionless rates r_e=T w_e.

Write p_r for the resulting full permutation endpoint law. The delivered theorem
claims a bound TV(p_r,p_q)<=epsilon, uniform over initial permutations, derived
from killed-pair survival and two-sided Duhamel smoothing. A deterministic color
projection F satisfies TV(F_*p_r,F_*p_q)<=epsilon. Random initial data may also be
included: condition on the initial data, apply the uniform bound, then average.
The joint law of (saved initial data, endpoint) inherits the same bound.

This last observation permits an endpoint-derived statistic, but does not turn an
endpoint certificate into a microscopic path or multi-time-process certificate.
Independent samples at different times do not reproduce temporal correlations.

## 2. Quantum random-SWAP channel

Assume n identical local Hilbert spaces of finite dimension d. Let U_e be the
unitary SWAP on edge e, and define the time-independent generator

    G_w(X) = sum_e w_e (U_e X U_e^dagger - X).

Assume H=0 and no other Lindblad term. The same independent Poisson clocks give a
random product of SWAPs. Grouping products by their endpoint permutation proves

    Phi_w,T(X) = sum_pi p_r(pi) U_pi X U_pi^dagger,

where r=T w and p_r is exactly the classical interchange endpoint law. This is a
classical permutation-mixture mechanism, already explicit in the quantum-gossip
literature; it is not a new quantum simulation mechanism.

# Finite time loss echo and its precision boundary

16 October 2026. Root follow-up to the independently constructed s04 loss echo and s07 finite-time audit. This closes an exact sampling-alias assumption, not the physical acquisition or practical conditioning problem. System realization and nonuniform sampling have substantial predecessors; no historical novelty is asserted.

## Exact two grid identification

Let A be an unknown conservative n-state column Markov generator, c=1^T, b a normalized preparation, and D a fixed unknown diagonal loss matrix with distinct entries. The illuminated generator is M=A-D. Fix positive times h1,h2,tau1,tau2 with h1/h2 and tau1/tau2 irrational. Define P1=exp(M h1), P2=exp(M h2), Q1=exp(A tau1), Q2=exp(A tau2).

Assume the sampled on-mode triple (P1,b,c) is minimal. Set C=[b,P1b,...,P1^(n-1)b] and O with rows cP1^i. The following finite scalar probabilities are available from single on intervals and two on intervals separated by darkness:

    H_ij = c P1^(i+j) b,
    J1_ij = c P1^(i+j+1) b,
    J2_ij = c P1^i P2 P1^j b,
    Kℓ_ij = c P1^i Qℓ P1^j b,    ℓ=1,2; 0≤i,j<n.

The J2 measurement is a single pulse of total duration (i+j)h1+h2. All matrices use the same H=OC. Therefore

    H^-1 Jℓ = C^-1 Pℓ C,
    H^-1 Kℓ = C^-1 Qℓ C.

The pair of exponentials at two incommensurate times uniquely determines each generator in this common basis, without a supplied rate cap. Proof: if exp(h1 X)=exp(h1 Y) and exp(h2 X)=exp(h2 Y), invertibility and commutation of these equal exponential matrices give exp((m h1+n h2)X)=exp((m h1+n h2)Y) for every integer m,n. The additive subgroup is dense in R. Continuity gives equality at all real times, and differentiation at zero gives X=Y. Apply this separately to M and A. Then C^-1 D C is known. Its simple spectrum gives physical state axes; normalize each eigenvector v by (cC)v=1, and only state permutation remains. Preparation b is recovered in the same basis.

Thus finite exact probabilities at finite positive durations can replace arbitrarily high derivatives and the single-grid logarithm branch assumption. A mere assertion that the on-mode is minimal is still a substantive restriction: simple D does not imply it. S07 has an exact singular-H counterexample. General switched-word identification may work there, but the compact H inverse operation does not.
